args.title: Saltmarsh Foods: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Saltmarsh Foods newsletter, its linked article, and the companion piece:

• Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter highlights "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article and a companion piece available via free registration.
• Article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
